propositions: A removal record for a never-peer-confirmed local link must be declined without writing an UNLINK event, keeping the link net-active locally and logging a WARNING.

The outbound ADD dedup on (vendor_type, target_key) allows a local link to collide with a same-vendor-type remote link in the opposite direction (local blocks vs inward depends_on), preventing its push and leaving the removal record unguarded by G4.
A link with peer-confirmation must still converge via relation-scoped removal, preserving existing behavior for synchronized links.
A confirmation with source=backfill must allow removal on first post-upgrade pass, unlike other confirmations that prevent removal.
An unopenable confirmation store must disable the check entirely, restoring pre-story removal behavior (fail-open contract).
The per-pass decline count must be reported in the INFO summary alongside impossible-link skip counts for operator visibility.
